annotations.title: 2026 business mileage deduction with mid-year rate change

description: Figure the 2026 standard mileage deduction using the first-half and second-half IRS rates, with parking and tolls, and compare it with actual vehicle expenses. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

compare.description: Compare with the actual-expense method. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: no = No; yes = Yes, using my vehicle costs.

gas.description: Gas, oil and fuel for the year (US dollars). All fuel for the vehicle, business and personal. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

insurance.description: Insurance (US dollars). Full-year premium for the vehicle. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

leaseOrDep.description: Lease payments or depreciation (your figure) (US dollars). Lease payments for the year, or depreciation from your depreciation schedule. Example only. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

milesH1.description: Business miles driven Jan 1 to Jun 30, 2026 (mi). From your mileage log. Leave out commuting and personal miles.

milesH2.description: Business miles driven Jul 1 to Dec 31, 2026 (mi). From your mileage log for the second half of the year.

otherCosts.description: Other vehicle costs (garage rent, interest if allowed) (US dollars). Other full-year vehicle costs you can support with records. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

parking.description: Business parking fees (US dollars). Parking for business trips. Not parking at your regular workplace.

rateH1.description: Standard mileage rate, Jan 1 to Jun 30, 2026 (USD/mi). Business standard mileage rate in dollars per mile. Official reference value 0.725 USD/mi from IRS Notice 2026-10 (IR-2025-128), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

rateH2.description: Standard mileage rate, Jul 1 to Dec 31, 2026 (USD/mi). Business standard mileage rate in dollars per mile. Official reference value 0.76 USD/mi from IRS Announcement 2026-11, 2026-29 I.R.B., effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

registration.description: Registration and license fees (US dollars). Full-year amount for the vehicle. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

repairs.description: Repairs, maintenance and tires (US dollars). Full-year amount for the vehicle. Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

tolls.description: Business tolls (US dollars). Tolls for business trips.

totalMiles.description: Total miles driven in 2026, all purposes (mi). Odometer at year end minus odometer at the start of the year (or when first used). Used only when compare is yes; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_2026_business_mileage_deduction_with_mid_year_rate

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
